Lausanne Park playground
We're replacing the playground at Lausanne Park (424 Lausanne Crescent)!
The new playground will stay in the same general area and offer similar features, just with new equipment and safety measures.
Once available, two designs for the new playground will be shared on this page, and you'll have the chance to vote on your favourite option.
